name: codenib
description: Source-linked answers about your repository: ranked search, compiler-indexed calls and references, and a Wiki whose every claim links to the exact lines.

args:
set -eu
if ! root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; then
  echo "CodeNib serves Git checkouts; open Codex inside one." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# CodeNib before 0.2.5 does not know the options passed below.
if command -v codenib >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
  codenib mcp --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '--defer-graph'; then
  set -- codenib
elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  set -- uvx --quiet --from "codenib[graph,mcp]>=0.2.5" codenib
elif command -v codenib >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "The installed CodeNib is older than 0.2.5: python -m pip install -U 'codenib[graph,mcp]'" >&2
  exit 1
else
  echo "CodeNib is not installed: python -m pip install 'codenib[graph,mcp]'" >&2
  exit 1
fi
"$@" index "$root" --preset fast >&2
exec "$@" mcp "$root" --defer-graph --tool-surface explore

interface.longDescription: Source-linked answers about your repository: ranked search, compiler-indexed calls and references, and a Wiki whose every claim links to the exact lines.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeNib to explain how this repository handles a request, citing files and lines
Use CodeNib to find what calls this function
